bundle=scratch/('published-expanded-'+run)
if bundle.exists():raise ValueError('Expanded archive destination already exists')

files=sorted(p for p in bundle.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
with archive.open('xb') as raw,gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=raw,mtime=0) as zipped,tarfile.open(fileobj=zipped,mode='w|',format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as tar:

def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(65536),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
# Verify every transported byte, without importing any checkout code.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=scratch,prefix='transport-check-') as temporary:
    with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
        for member in tar:
            expected=run+'/'
            if not member.isfile() or not member.name.startswith(expected) or '..' in Path(member.name).parts:raise ValueError('Unsafe transport member')

            with tar.extractfile(member) as source,target.open('xb') as output:shutil.copyfileobj(source,output)
    restored=Path(temporary)/run
    actual={str(p.relative_to(restored)):sha(p) for p in restored.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    expected={str(p.relative_to(bundle)):sha(p) for p in files}
    if actual!=expected:raise ValueError('Transport changed immutable bundle bytes')
